name: Charleston & Savannah
about: Spring (Mar–Apr) brings blooming azaleas and mild weather, the most popular season; summer (Jun–Sep) is brutally hot and humid, best avoided for walking tours.
overview: Two of America's best-preserved historic Southern cities — antebellum architecture, moss-draped squares, and excellent Southern food, a short drive apart.
costOverview: Sweet tea and casual Southern food are affordable — historic-home tours and the region's top-tier restaurants are where the real spending happens.
